app.title: Muse Code and Muse Spark 1.2
app.author: paulkrush
app.description: Muse Code is a research code platform that enables the development and deployment of AI models.
proposed_tests: Install Muse Code CLI and create a new project
Write a simple AI model using Muse Code's API
Test model accuracy using the Muse Code testing framework
Compare Muse Code's performance with other research platforms
